description:
Meditation Music | Slow Bansuri | 1.5 Hour Healing

If your jaw is clenched and your shoulders are at your ears — start here. Bansuri is the closest sound to your own breath finally remembering itself. Let the flute breathe for you for 90 minutes.

90 minutes of slow bamboo flute music, played to help your body slow down and reset.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Bansuri — the bamboo flute, one of the most breath-driven instruments in Indian classical music
- Long flowing notes with natural breathing pauses
- A gentle healing frequency layer to help the nervous system soften
- Unbroken sound — no abrupt fades, no startling moments

⏱ Chapters
0:00   Settling — first conscious breath
15:00  Breath finding rhythm
40:00  Body releasing
70:00  Settled calm
85:00  Gentle return

🧠 How to use:
Press play. Don't try to breathe deep — let the flute set the pace. Sit upright. Phone face down.

⏱ Best for:
• Anxiety relief
• Morning grounding
• Pre-meeting calm
• Breathwork practice
• Held-tension days

📺 Subscribe to Raga Focus for daily uploads:
- Sitar, Sarangi, Veena, Surbahar, Bansuri, Tanpura and other Indian instruments
- Music for anxiety, overthinking, sleep, stress, emotional release

— Raga Focus

thumbnail_prompt: Pichwai/Kangra miniature painting style, ornate gold-and-cream patterned border with peacock and lotus motifs, aged warm parchment background, soft daylight palette (warm cream with subtle morning light glow, no harsh dawn/dusk specificity). Central figure: a serene woman in cream-and-gold sari with sage-green accents seated cross-legged by a still mountain stream, holding bansuri to her lips. Single dewdrop on a lotus leaf as visual breath-cue. Gentle mist softening the scene. Bold dark-teal serif overlay text reading 'STRESSED OUT?' top-center, traditional Devanagari-influenced serif typography, high contrast for mobile readability. Aged warm cream parchment palette, single composed scene, no clutter.
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Warm bansuri flute solo in raga Ahir Bhairav, deep grounding morning healing breath-driven mood, smooth breath-driven melodic flow with gentle gamak ornamentation, sustained drone-resolving phrases with natural breathing pauses, no percussion, no tabla, 432Hz tuning, 70-80 BPM, expressive melodic phrases with clear note movement and natural phrasing, cinematic meditation production, meditative but melodic, suitable for extended looping, begins immediately with first melodic phrase already in motion, no fade-in, no silent intro, full sonic presence from first note. deeply introspective, like breath held before release

production_spec.loop_seam: 10s in / 30s out, Suno extend 3-4x → loop in post to fill 90 min
production_spec.notes: EMOTIONAL TAG ROTATION: clip 1 introspective · clip 2 hopeful · clip 3 settled · clips 4-7 cycle. Ahir Bhairav tonic D. Morning tempo (70-80). Mix: Suno -3dB, Binaural -18dB, Tanpura -24dB. Bansuri mid-register/warm, not high-pitched.

experiment_notes: Hypothesis 1: 'Meditation Music' (VidIQ 80) as fresh lead in morning Bansuri AVD lane outperforms locked 'Anxiety Relief Music'. Wraps anxiety intent in meditation/healing framing per Truth 5 strategic note. Hypothesis 2 (VARIANT B): Moksha 'Start Your Day With Peace' pattern (23K views proven) replicates on our channel — tests timezone-agnostic rule against empirical competitor counter-evidence. Hypothesis 3 (VARIANT C): 'Healing Music' (75 VidIQ) lead with 'Morning Calm' specifier — tests whether the morning angle in slot 3 changes performance vs Variant A's 'Healing' suffix. Hypothesis 4: Specific-state Q-thumbs ('STRESSED OUT?', 'MIND RACING?') vs outcome-imperative thumb ('BREATHE EASY') — tests Q-format wins in anxiety lane (Test 9).
